program_dir=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-high-fresh0/frozen/held-out-reference-3/play/users/u071/system/state/workspace/programs')
program_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
source='''from collections import deque

def transform(grid):
    rows, cols = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    seen = [[False] * cols for _ in range(rows)]
    largest_size = -1
    largest_color = 0
    for r in range(rows):
        for c in range(cols):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == 0 or seen[r][c]:
                continue
            q = deque([(r, c)])
            seen[r][c] = True
            size = 0
            while q:
                y, x = q.popleft()
                size += 1
                for dy, dx in ((1, 0), (-1, 0), (0, 1), (0, -1)):
                    ny, nx = y + dy, x + dx
                    if 0 <= ny < rows and 0 <= nx < cols and not seen[ny][nx] and grid[ny][nx] == color:
                        seen[ny][nx] = True
                        q.append((ny, nx))
            if size > largest_size:
                largest_size, largest_color = size, color
    return [[largest_color] * 3 for _ in range(3)]
'''
